elyos.title: Dawn Legion Base
description: A hidden Dawn Legion base in Verteron’s Cantas<br class="mobile"> Valley, concealed<br class="pc"> within a secluded ravine<br class="mobile"> and used as their secret command center.

elyos.title: Cantas Valley
description: Once a vital Odylium hub for the Daeva, this<br class="mobile"> abandoned land was left barren<br class="pc"> after depletion, now<br class="mobile"> scavenged by the Dawn Legion for remaining traces.

elyos.title: Ellun River Marsh
description: A ruined swamp downstream of the Ellun<br class="mobile"> River, now occupied by<br class="pc"> the Illusion Cavaliers<br class="mobile"> as they rebuild Verteron’s fallen Barrier Tower.

elyos.title: Aullaeu Village
description: An Aullaeu settlement at Tolbas Forest’s edge,<br class="pc"> home<br class="mobile"> to Balaur servants and a source of the forest’s unrest.

elyos.title: Altamia Canyon
description: A submerged canyon in eastern Verteron,<br class="mobile"> once home to the<br class="pc"> Zumion Temple, now<br class="mobile"> resurfaced under the Notos Legion’s watch.

asmodians.title: Safe Haven
description: A former haven for criminals in northern<br class="mobile"> Altgard, now an unlikely<br class="pc"> refuge untouched<br class="mobile"> by Balaur assaults after the Dredgion’s fall.

asmodians.title: Dredgion Crash Site
description: A scorched canyon where a Fafnir Legion<br class="mobile"> Dredgion crashed, leaking<br class="pc"> Drakana that corrupted<br class="mobile"> the land and left the area dangerously isolated.

asmodians.title: Sanctum Outpost
description:
Once a sacred sanctuary of the Empyrean
Lord Zikel, this fallen land is now a Balaur
stronghold where Draconute Warriors
transform captured Daevas into Fafnites.

asmodians.title: Moslan Forest
description: Once a thriving sanctuary of the Elim and Nornir,<br class="mobile"> this forest was consumed<br class="pc"> by Hystan’s flames,<br class="mobile"> leaving only wounded Elim among the ashes.

asmodians.title: Nornir Assembly
description: A hidden Nornir settlement built by refugees<br class="mobile"> of Moslan Forest, protected<br class="pc"> by ancient magic<br class="mobile"> and guided by Urd of the Three Sisters of Fate.

factions.title: Elyos
description:
Guardians of Light,
Wings of Grace
layer: The Elyos–Asmodian War ended with the fall of the Aion Tower. The barrier could not hold under the weight of strife and the world was consumed by the final flames of war, forever known as the Last War.
As the Tower fell and the barrier faded, the Balaur descended upon Elysea. The Empyrean Lords sacrificed themselves to forge a wall of light, sealing the world in a radiant veil of eternal isolation.
The Bulwark rose through endless sacrifice, consuming Siel and draining the remaining Lords, leaving some destroyed and others hollowed of their light.
With the barrier gone, Atreia fell into war as Dragon Lords Ishtar and Fafnir engulfed Poeta in fire and shadow, leaving countless lives in ruin.
Beyond the Bulwark, a Daeva’s Ascension was no longer a blessing. Now they were hunted, bound to Surana, and reshaped into aberrations that turned on their own kind.

factions.title: Asmodians
description:
Forged in Shadows,
Wings of Dominion
layer: The Elyos–Asmodian War ended with the fall of the Aion Tower. The barrier could not hold under the weight of strife and the world was consumed by the final flames of war, forever known as the Last War.
When the barrier fell, Asmodae was left defenseless as the Balaur surged in like an endless tide. In their final stand, the Empyrean Lords raised a wall of light, sealing the realm in shadow.
With Israphel fallen, the five remaining Empyrean Lords gave everything, forging the Bulwark from their blood and souls as Asmodae’s final shield.

Beyond the Bulwark lay a world ripe for conquest, as Dragon Lords Ishtar and Fafnir crushed Ishalgen and devoured the continent. Though the Bulwark halted their advance, the land beyond remained under their dominion.
The Daeva, once destined for light, were consumed by darkness as Fafnir shattered their souls and sealed their light in crystal prisons, turning them into harbingers of destruction.
